oracles.tool: helm-oracle (Go text/template/parse for templates, gopkg.in/yaml.v3 for Chart.yaml and values.yaml)

notes: L2 (ref_recall, ref_precision) is scored on include/template calls made inside a named template: 3,511 literal-name calls, 3,052 distinct (template, callee) pairs; 44,852 more (92.7% of the 48,363 in the two subjects) sit in manifest bodies outside any define, belong to no symbol and are not call edges: they are HelmTemplateRef symbols, scored at L1

L3 edges: 181 (bitnami/charts 174, prometheus-community/helm-charts 7), by the dependency's repository: 1 file:// path and 180 oci:// registry addresses, no URLs; only the file:// edge is a local path helm itself resolves, the rest join a dependency's name to the one in-repo chart of that name (the monorepo convention the package.json dialect also uses) and would be false where an unrelated chart shares the name
a file whose extraction instantiated a grammar module after the warm-up (an injected language) is timed on a second, warm extraction

helm v3.19.0 `helm show chart` loaded all 161 charts (115 in bitnami/charts, 46 in prometheus-community/helm-charts) with the same name and dependency names as the oracle's walk; `helm template` (tier A) was not run: the charts' dependencies are remote (oci:// or https), so a render needs `helm dependency build` over the network for every chart

kinds: the K8sWorkload and K8sContainer symbols fusion's helmtemplateyaml.go recovers from templated manifests are not emitted by this dialect (the go-template grammar leaves a manifest's YAML as opaque text); lang-parity against fusion's dispatch reads MERGE (sym_recall .5475 to 1.0, sym_precision .9963 to 1.0) with those two kinds lost, so dispatch stays on the incumbents until that loss has an owner

oracle tier C throughout, so every grade is capped at good (section 1.3): Chart.yaml and values.yaml keys come from gopkg.in/yaml.v3 (the doc engine's own library; aliases followed, merge keys applied), templates from Go's text/template/parse (independent of the tree-sitter grammar), and the L3 join from a re-implementation of the unique-chart-name rule (calibration/oracles/helm) that attests the implementation, not the rule
per-file times exclude the one-time grammar compile (an untimed warm-up extraction precedes timing)
prometheus-community/helm-charts: 277 tool-oracle entries on files fathom does not read (ingest's gates, discovery's exclusions) were left out of scope (§1.4)
prometheus-community/helm-charts: 6 files skipped by ingest's gates (generated)

sym_recall 0.99999 (208,711 of 208,713), sym_precision 1.0 (no dialect-only definition): the two misses are one bitnami/charts line, seaweedfs webadv/ingress.yaml:42, where `("https" "http" .Values.webdav.tls.enabled)` is a command starting with a string, which Go's parser accepts and the go-template grammar does not, so its error recovery loses the include and the .Values accessor on that line
